name: robots/electronicelephant__pybullet_ur5_robotiq
title: UR5 arm with Robotiq-85/140 gripper in a PyBullet push-and-grasp scene
intro: UR5 arm with Robotiq-85/140 gripper in a PyBullet push-and-grasp scene, adapted from electronicelephant/pybullet_ur5_robotiq. It reads `observation`, `tick`, `episode` and `info`; runs `step` and `reset_world`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
